disabled.title: Run tracking is not enabled
disabled.description: This deployment has not switched on run tracking, so no runs are being recorded for this Bot.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: Recorded runs of this Bot appear here once tracking has captured one.

forbidden.title: You cannot view this Bot's runs
forbidden.description: Run records belong to the Bot's creator and administrators; access to the Bot is not enough.

basic.title: Basic-level record
basic.description: This run was observed at basic level: it shows what passed through OpenBot, not the runtime's internal steps.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: Part of this run was withheld by the redaction policy before it was stored.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: Part of this run exceeded the field limit and was cut short; the full content was never stored.

syncing.title: Runs are still syncing
syncing.description: A finished run reaches this page shortly after it ends; give it a moment.

unavailable.title: Run records are unavailable
unavailable.description: The tracking service could not be reached, so run records cannot be shown right now. The runs themselves were not affected.
